control.note: Paper's Mip-splatting row was run with the EFA repo's Mip-Splatting code (GOF abs-grad densification). efa-gs-base = same plugin with LFCF off (official interval_times = inf). Run it in the same experiment; the gain efa-gs - efa-gs-base is compared with paper EFA - Mip (garden -0.02, bonsai +0.22). Secondary older-base reference: runs/mip-splatting-i1-pilr/mip-splatting/mipnerf360-pilr-garden (paper-era Mip, 27.43); no paper-era Mip run exists for bonsai.

paper_targets.source: cw_main.tex Appendix table resofmippsnr (EFA-GS(Mip)); per-scene SSIM/LPIPS in paper_results.json

notes: Official scripts use -r 4 / -r 2 PIL resize of full-res images -> mipnerf360-pilr dataset. Scenes: garden (outdoor) + bonsai (indoor; largest reported EFA gain, also used in the paper's ablation/speed tables). Renderer background black (official); the gsplat baseline uses white. Single seed. Smoke (2k steps, pilr garden) in evidence/test.json. Record #Gaussians and training time per run (paper Tab. speed: bonsai EFA 22'55" vs Mip 25'05").
